headline: Stop the Saturday slip—Huel discipline and 45 minutes now
summary: You're gaining 0.01kg weekly when you need to lose 0.73kg; today you break the pattern with pre-portioned Huel and intentional movement.
details: Saturday is your snacking weakness—commit to Huel meals today with zero emotional additions, no exceptions. Get 45 minutes on the rowing machine or treadmill right now; this creates the deficit you've been avoiding. This weekend choice matters: every Saturday you stay disciplined cuts 3kg off your catch-up, and you need all 33kg to hit 88kg by June 2027.
